period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2016. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2017 (9-month YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Jul-Sep 2017) figures (net loss after tax BDT -98.88m, EPS -0.15), not stored as separate line items, consistent with this dataset's convention. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; extracted via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3). Cross-checks: the 31-Dec-2016 comparative (total assets 12,257.72m) matches this dataset's own 2016_Q4.json exactly; the income-statement chain (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, tax=0 this period) closes exactly for both the current and comparative columns. Retained earnings for 30-Sep-2017 was illegible under OCR in this file's own balance sheet; reconstructed via the balance-sheet identity to -17,606,211,136, then INDEPENDENTLY corroborated exactly by the 2018_Q3 filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity comparative row for 'Balance as at 30 September 2017'. This filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity also shows a small (~25,291 taka) 'change in accounting policy' adjustment to the 1-January-2017 opening balance, and repeats a 'Balance as at 1 January 2017' row twice with a tiny (~1 taka rounding-level) inconsistency between the two instances -- noted but not material and not further investigated given the bank's overall multi-billion-taka scale.
